train_classification_model: train a classification model using a config file with multi-GPU support and automatic checkpointing
run_train_epoch: run one epoch of training with forward pass, loss computation, backward pass, and parameter updates
evaluate_model: evaluate the model on the test set and compute top-1 and top-5 error rates
auto_match_model_flops: automatically adjust model dimensions to match a target FLOP or parameter count baseline
log_model_info: log model architecture, parameter count, FLOP count, and node count to console and tensorboard
